title: Guided no-SQL query builder
description:
The core of the goal: let a non-technical user ask questions without writing SQL/Cypher. A visual query builder — pick an entity type (e.g. Yachts), then add filters via dropdowns/sliders (Builder is X, LOA between A and B, Region is Y, Owner net worth over Z), optionally 'connected to' a related entity (Yachts whose Builder is in Region = Italy). Runs against the in-memory graph and renders results in the sortable table component. Show the plain-English restatement of the query above the results ('Showing yachts built by Feadship, over 80m, available in the Caribbean'). Saveable/shareable via URL query params.

Part of Phase 3 (Query & Reports). This is the single most important ticket for the stated goal.
acceptance_criteria: A user can select an entity type and add multiple attribute filters via UI controls (no text query language)
Filters support equality, range (numeric), and 'related-to' relationship constraints across one hop
Results render in the sortable/filterable table component with a live result count
A plain-English restatement of the current query is shown above the results
The query state is encoded in the URL so a query can be bookmarked/shared and reproduces the same results
